Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq_qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 01 s. 2024 JAN 03 HON. IVAN REEGO BINOBO Acting Municipal Federation President Sangguniang Kabataan Federation of Arakan Arakan, Cotabato Dear Hon. Binobo: This pertains to your letter dated April 18, 2023 which was forwarded to us by Regional Director Josephine Cabrido-Leysa, DILG Region-Xll, requesting legal opinion on the following: I. Can you be given the privilege to be given due compensation such as salary and representation and travel allowance (RATA) on the date you assumed as the Acting Pederasyon President, an ex officio Member of the Sangguniang Bayan when the incumbent President is already on leave without pay? 2. Is the DILG Opinion No. 147, s.2022 applies to your case in LGU Arakan? The foregoing queries were prompted by the following: • • On December 2022 to May 31 , 2023, the incumbent Pederasyon President filed his leave of absence on reason of medical treatment. From December 2022 to February 7, 2023, the incumbent Pederasyon President is on leave with pay, and on February 8, 2023 to May 31, 2023, he is on leave without pay already. As a result, you assumed the responsibility and duties of the SK Federation President being the SK Municipal Federation Vice President. You raised this query based on DILG Opinion No. 147, Series of 2022 on the case of Hon. Karl J. Silverio, SK Municipal Federation Vice President of San Miguel, Iloilo, in which case, he automatically assumed the office of the concerned Pederasyon President because he was detained in violation of RA 10951 or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunitions Regulation Act which automatically exercise the powers and performs the duties and functions appurtenant to the office. Hence, the queries. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

At the outset, the SK Pederasyon Vice President cannot validly claim the salary pertaining to the Office of the SK Pederasyon President because the exercise of the powers and performance of the duties and functions of the president is merely brought about by the temporary absence of the latter (Section 41(b), DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-11). Basic is the rule that salary attached to the office itself and not to the officer. What salary or emoluments that may be attached by law to a public office do not belong to the incumbent because of any supposed legal duty resulting upon the public to pay for the services rendered by him. On the other hand, on the issue of RATA, an employee whose position is not authorized by law to collect the same but is designated to a position vacated temporarily by the incumbent on account of his leave of absence or other legal reasons, shall be entitled to the regular RATA of the position on the reimbursable basis2. As to the query on whether DILG Opinion No. 147, s.2022 applies to your case in Arakan, we answer in the affirmative. The Vice President of the Pederasyon, in case of temporary vacancy in the Office of the President of the Pederasyon, shall automatically assume as Acting President of the Pederasyon until such time as that the incumbent Pederasyon President reassumes his/her office. Correspondingly, the Acting Pederasyon President shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions appurtenant to the office. The phrase "automatically exercise" means that upon the happening of the situation or incident that temporarily incapacitates the concerned pederasyon president (e.g. leave of absence, travel abroad, suspension from office, and the like), the pederasyon vice-president assumes as acting president and there is no need for the issuance of another document before he can exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the pederasyon president. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, B AU ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: VI OR R.
